messages:
elaine: quick idea  add a scope picker to the create flow so keys default to least-privilege. mock: dropdown with checkboxes (read-only, embeddings-only, full).

 tom: like least-privilege by default. UX Q: should we hide advanced scopes under an 'Advanced' expander to reduce noise?

 raj: dev POV  showing scopes inline helps auditing. backend supports scopes array: ["read","embed"]. also can return a compatibility preview of routes that will fail if scope missing.

 nick: accessibility: scope checkboxes need clear labels and a help text per scope. when user toggles a broad scope, announce a warning via aria-live: "Warning: this key will allow full access". avoid modal dialogs for warnings.

 tom: microcopy idea for the warning: "This key will grant access to all routes. Prefer creating a scoped key for least privilege." small link: "See examples".

 elaine: empty state tweak: current 'No API keys' -> propose: 'No API keys yet  create a scoped key to limit blast radius.' CTA: 'Create scoped key'.

 raj: feature idea: bulk-assign scopes when creating multiple keys in quick-create. UI: CSV upload or multi-row editor. backend: accept batch POST.

 nick: keyboard note: multi-row editor must support row editing via keyboard, inline validation announced live, and each row should have aria-describedby for errors.

 tom: revoke semantics: propose 'soft-revoke' toggle so infra teams can mark a key as disabled (doesn't delete) to allow quick rollback. copy: "Disable key (can re-enable)" vs "Revoke permanently".

 elaine: next steps: raj to prototype scope preview API, nick to draft a11y patterns for the picker and batch editor, tom to write microcopy variants, i'll add to roadmap doc and schedule a quick review.

 deploy-bot: figma mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/scope-picker-v1 :rocket:
